summary.quantification_method: Absolute quantification using heavy labeled peptide standards (spiked-in)

quantification_strategy: Absolute quantification using heavy labeled peptide standards (spiked-in)

acquisition: The Fusion was operated in a data dependent mode.
Full MS1 scans were collected in the Orbitrap at 120k resolution.
labeling: Heavy labeled peptides were spiked-in to the digested samples at appropriate concentrations
Peptides used were: SFEDIHQYR for HRAS; SFADINLYR for NRAS; SFEDIHHYR for KRAS; LVVVGAGGVGK for wild-type H/N/KRAS; LVVVGAGDVGK for G13D mutant H/N/KRAS, and LVVVGAVGVGK for G12V mutant H/N/KRAS
quantification: Peak area quantitation of the heavy peptides and corresponding light peptides from the samples were extracted by Skyline.
Within each sample, we used mutant Ras as a standard to normalize against.
enrichment: Isolation of active GTP bound Ras was performed using the Active Ras Pull-Down and Detection Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific,)
RBD lysates from cetuximab treated and non-treated cells (CTX; 20μg/ml for 48h) were precipitated using Methanol-Chloroform.
workflow_hints: Proteins were then trypsin digested overnight at 37° C.

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The PRIDE metadata lists 'SILAC' as a quantification method, but the text explicitly describes a spiked-in heavy peptide standard approach (AQUA/targeted-style quantification) rather than metabolic SILAC labeling. The acquisition is clearly DDA. The assay uses an RBD (Ras Binding Domain) pull-down to enrich for active GTP-bound Ras.

scope: Isolation of active GTP bound Ras was performed using the Active Ras Pull-Down and Detection Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific,)
RBD lysates from cetuximab treated and non-treated cells (CTX; 20μg/ml for 48h) were precipitated using Methanol-Chloroform.
Ras abundance was measured by Western blot and/or by mass spectrometry.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry consisted of active Ras proteins isolated via an RBD (Ras Binding Domain) pull-down assay, which is a form of affinity purification.
